question: Are there positives every model contradicts, and does down-weighting them help?

design.protocol: NESTED repeated CV, paired on byte-identical outer folds
design.fold_source: muleguard.models.nested.build_outer_folds (the same function the nested tournament uses)
design.outer_validation_labels: used once per arm, for scoring only
design.hyperparameters: each family at its default configuration, identical across arms - not tuned per arm
design.yardstick: paired differences on fixed folds. The project's 0.0905 PR-AUC seed-noise floor is an UNPAIRED figure and does not apply here; each comparison is judged against its own std_of_paired_diff.
design.power_warning: each outer-validation fold holds ~13 positives, so fold-level average precision is extremely coarse and almost nothing in this programme can reach significance. Null results mean 'no effect of this size', never 'no effect'.
design.flag_rule: a positive that EVERY family ranks below the median of all rows, in every repeat it is validated in

arms.fold_local_downweight: flagged training positives weighted x0.5; flags from this fold's inner-OOF only
arms.globally_flagged_downweight: IDENTICAL except the flags come from the pooled outer-validation predictions - REJECTED EVIDENCE, run only to measure the size of that leak

audit.policy: FLAG ONLY. Nothing is relabelled and no positive is deleted.

paired_fold_local_vs_baseline.yardstick: paired on identical outer folds - judge against std_of_paired_diff=0.01585, NOT against the project's 0.0905 unpaired seed-noise floor

paired_globally_flagged_vs_baseline.yardstick: paired on identical outer folds - judge against std_of_paired_diff=0.01531, NOT against the project's 0.0905 unpaired seed-noise floor

paired_leak_minus_local.yardstick: paired on identical outer folds - judge against std_of_paired_diff=0.00848, NOT against the project's 0.0905 unpaired seed-noise floor

decision.rule: KEEP only if the FOLD-LOCAL arm beats the baseline with a positive mean paired gain and at least 2 of 3 tests p < 0.05. The globally-flagged arm can never justify a change no matter what it scores.
